{{Top}}
[[File:Jaraelsears.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Jarael]], an [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]] with [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] blood, had pointed ears.]]
{{Quote|So I squeeze off a couple of shots, trying to get their attention&mdash;which ''works''&mdash;and then I throw my last detonator at 'em. Hard as I can. It taps ''right'' as they're unrolling, right before their shields go up. Next thing I know, my ears are ringing. I'm covered in flaming droid parts.|[[Syke (clone trooper)|Syke]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
An '''ear''' was part of the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] anatomy, usually on either side of the humanoid head. Ears were primarily used for hearing. During the [[Swarm War]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] pretended to cut off [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] ear with a [[laser scalpel]] during a mock-[[Torture/Legends|torture]] session.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Species/Legends|species]] possessed earholes.<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref> The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species had long ears which aided them in swimming.<ref name="SWE Gungans">{{SWE|groups|gungans|Gungans}}</ref>
